files.note: Read the window shell: Pane and ShellTarget types, the App/Window split, pane wiring, chrome hooks and screen routing; no independent logic fault found.
Read the window title builder and its version/needing count inputs; plural and waiting-count wording checked. Clean.
Read bootMark and its stage marks; it records only when timing is enabled and keeps no state beyond the marks. Clean.
Read the icon and blur chooser: a pick saves, applies the window look, and puts the CSS blur back when the Rust apply fails. Matches SET-041.
Read the ask/answer key helper and the question component; keys are scoped, answers clear, and a stale question id is not reused. Clean.
Read the grid layout chooser: the count comes from the caller and each press reports the chosen layout; no off-by-one found. Clean.
Read the out-of-flow wrapper: it renders children into a positioned box and changes nothing else in the tree. Clean.
Read the right sidebar tabs, width persistence, narrow More menu, panel error boundary and grip resizing; remembered-tab fallback checked. Clean.
Read the status bar's two-second memory poll, item visibility menu and keep-awake item; polling stops while hidden and the menu reads the saved list. Clean.
Read the delayed tooltip: one timer, cleared on leave, and no tip is shown while the pointer is down. Clean.
Read the top bar screens list, switcher cycle order and drag regions; SCREEN_IDS matches the Screen union and Classic hides the switcher. Clean.
Read the agent vendor mark: an unknown agent falls back to the neutral mark instead of throwing. Clean.
Read the icon and blur readers plus applyWindowBlur; unknown icons read classic, only a saved true blurs, and a refusal keeps the page solid. Clean.
Read menu accelerators, menu state, edit dispatch, setting flips and help actions; HINT_FROM maps menu zoom to the interface zoom keys. Clean.
Read the dialog and menu focus traps, Tab wrapping, capture-phase Escape, menu room and arrow stepping; only the top shown modal answers. Clean.
Read the icon set from the shared Glyph through Mark, the later glyph components and StatusGlyph; names, paths and status glyph mapping checked. Clean.
Read the modal stack: push and release keep identity, isTopModal skips hidden dialogs, and release removes an entry wherever it sits. Clean.
Read the notice sink: one setter, sentences dropped before mount, and the sink cleared on unmount. Clean.
Read the palette open store and its subscription hook; the external store snapshot is stable and listeners are released. Clean.
Read the pulse rest timer: input wakes it, the running cycle ends before it rests, and cleanup removes every passive listener and cancels the wait. Clean.
Read screen reach: Classic keeps switcher screens on Terminals and the palette rows use the same screen target. Clean.
Read closed-tab records, the folder check, ring take with path forms, pane rebuild and cell placement; full grids fall back to the first cell. Clean.
Read status item ids, saved hidden-list filtering and the usage pill rule; retired or unknown ids drop out and visibility defaults to shown. Clean.
Read Classic/New layout mapping and header width: a hidden sidebar gives the minimum, and width rounds the sidebar plus its gap. Clean.
Read palette, notice and toast state, the native chord store, help actions and menu sync; the toast timer re-arms only while hovered. Clean.
Read the screens hook: one screen at a time and the setter is stable; Classic is forced to Terminals in useWindowChrome. Clean.
Read the title count, keymap notice, Classic screen reset and the settings-link listener; every effect has a matching cleanup. Clean.
Read crash text extraction, the report button and feedback: stack lines are bounded and retry is disabled while a report is sending. Clean.
Read field description, selection checks, clipboard actions and the popup menu; terminal edits stay copy and select-all only. Clean.
Read field kinds, menu item construction and shortcut labels; unavailable rows are left out and disabled rows cannot run. Clean.
Read the suggestion gate: waits a short beat, ignores stale suggestions and closes on blur; its timer and token handling checked. Clean.
Read banned-word matching and the glossary getters; hover keys are excluded by the lookup caller and every id has both plain and hover text. Clean.
Read the English text catalogue and its key type; keys are literal and checked for accidental duplicates by the compiler. Clean.
Read pack registration, one load per language, English fallback and value substitution; a failed pack load leaves English and can retry later. Clean.
Read the bundled pack registry: modules load lazily and only known languages are registered. Clean.
Read the Spanish pack metadata and texts; keys exist in the English catalogue and only translated strings are exported. Clean.
Read the French pack metadata and texts; keys exist in the English catalogue and only translated strings are exported. Clean.
Read the Japanese pack metadata and texts; keys exist in the English catalogue and only translated strings are exported. Clean.
Read the Korean pack metadata and texts; keys exist in the English catalogue and only translated strings are exported. Clean.
Read the Simplified Chinese pack metadata and texts; keys exist in the English catalogue and only translated strings are exported. Clean.
Read the named command list and invoke wrapper; command names are a closed union and the wrapper adds no hidden arguments. Clean.
Read the keymap provider, file load and save, label helpers and context hooks; a stale save is guarded and missing contexts have defaults. Clean.
Read the 95-action table, platform defaults, aliases and index flags; no duplicate ids and every index action has a digit default. Clean.
Read command rows, window commands, rename targets, the reload question and worktree-off notes; every id resolves to an action. Clean.
Read double-tap matching: same physical key, about 300 ms, no other modifier held and repeats ignored; spelling round-trips. Clean.
Read the surface-to-scope map: settings, terminal and tab surfaces map to the expected scope lists. Clean.

Read chord parsing and labels, file sections, conflict dropping, yielding and matching. Two faults filed: T7-F01 counts one binding's duplicate chord as a clash, T7-F02 leaves a recorded Mod+0 un-normalised.
Read the palette stand-in key and hint: a palette pick answers once and the hint excludes chords already taken. Clean.
Read the recorder: modifiers, Escape cancel, code-to-key spelling and index normalisation; its Ctrl+0 input exposes the T7-F02 fault in keymap.normaliseIndexChord. Clean here.
Read command stand-in events, scope notes and the running-command guard; an answer consumes the key once and leaves later presses alone. Clean.
Read first-load seeding: an unreadable file retries, the marker prevents repeats, and a file naming any of the four commands is untouched. Clean.
Read old tab pairing seeding: new installs untouched, any section naming an id stops it, and malformed keybindings are left for the user. Clean.
Read tap-to-command matching: only global, tabs and terminal scopes qualify and old ids map through matchOf. Clean.
Read the terminal policy reader and helpers; unknown policies fall back, the field is a closed list and the terminal scope is respected. Clean.
Read the window key handler end to end: overlays hold keys, typing holds own-key chords, the switch covers every action, and index commands use hit.index with a 0 fallback. Clean.
Read language choices, saved and system resolution, Traditional Chinese fallback and listener cleanup; the primary OS tag decides. Clean.
Read staged lazy loading: stages advance on time and input, active windows stay warm, and forget clears timers. Clean.
Read the menu lazy exports: every named export maps to a module and stays behind Suspense. Clean.
Read the page lazy exports and their fallbacks; no heavy page is imported eagerly. Clean.
Read the pane lazy export and fallback; a missing chunk shows the fallback instead of crashing the window. Clean.
Read the UI menu wrappers: Menu, ContextMenu and MenuItem forward props and keep the lazy boundary. Clean.
Read the card detail chooser: locked status cannot be unticked and each tick saves through detailsAfter. Clean.
Read card indent steps; depth is clamped at zero and grows by one level at a time. Clean.
Read finish labels, metals and the finish body: unknown metals fall back and strength stays inside its span. Clean.
Read the header badge and swatch picker: only palette ids are saved, the chosen swatch is the Tab stop, and arrows wrap. Clean.
Read the sidebar look and card density bodies; saved values go through the readers and clamps, and labels match the stored ids. Clean.
Read changed-file counting, the one-at-a-time queue, the TTL cache and focus/finish refresh; a failed read keeps the last count and never blocks drawing. Clean.
Read own-port filtering, the TTL cache and single-flight scans; failed scans keep the last answer and a hover never shows an error. Clean.
Read density presets, custom detail lists, preset markers, port and task lines, and hover text; tidy order and marker round-trip checked. Clean.
Read finish resolution, metals, glass spans and the ground/vars helpers; unknown finishes read flat and values stay in span. Clean.
Read palette filtering, pick and forget, plus group-delete cleanup; grey is never saved and sub-groups are included in the gone set. Clean.
Read sidebar looks, strength span, tint default and wash cap; the terminal look takes the terminal ground and tint is clamped. Clean.
Read stage pools, pixel stretching and picture selection; the same seed gives the same picture and an unknown pool falls back. Clean.
Read boot: cached appearance first, settings settle, language and theme apply, then crash reporting; timing marks record only when enabled. Clean.
Read the missing-file toast: a null stamp reports the file name, a failed check never blocks the open. Clean.
Read the open-external wrapper; it delegates the address checks to the Rust side and rejects with its words. Clean.
Read the open-in list cleaning, targets, command fallback and relInside; relative file paths are rejected when they escape the worktree root. Clean.
Read app editing and duplicate detection; both fields are required, an unchanged row keeps its id, and a command already listed is refused. Clean.
Read the asleep pane: wake is disabled while waking and the hidden state keeps the pane layout. Clean.
Read sleep settings, idle clamping, due selection and the persisted stamp; invalid numbers fall back and disabled sleep selects nothing. Clean.
Read the minute tick, re-check before sleep, wake resume line and idle restart; a stale tick is skipped and a refusal keeps the pane asleep with a toast. Clean.
Read the switcher hook, view and Escape watch; busy groups are not switchable and the capture listener closes the menu once. Clean.
Read account labels, duplicate disambiguation, pick and cycle rules, and palette rows; an unlisted active id reads as System default. Clean.
Read the test click and typing helpers: events bubble to React handlers and label lookup is bounded to the host tree. Clean.
Read the stand-in DOM: node tree, attributes, listeners, events and animation stubs; only what React asks for is implemented and nothing leaks between tests. Clean.
Read the source-reading helper: files resolve under src and a missing file reports a clear error. Clean.
Read token tables, appearance read/write, contrast floors, built-in and custom themes, terminal mapping and appearance vars; clamps keep values in span. Clean.
Read the dialog and alert wrappers: focus trapping and Escape go through the shared hooks, and labels are wired. Clean.
Read the menu and context menu components: row roles, disabled handling and focus trap keys. Clean.
Read the select wrapper: option list, change forwarding and disabled state stay in step with props. Clean.
Read tabs, tab list and tab panel: aria wiring and controlled selection stay in step. Clean.
Read the layer hook and point anchoring: one layer at a time and the anchor is clamped to the window. Clean.
Read workspace grouping, grid roots, dirKey/sameDir/underDir, removal, stays and fallback; absolute Windows paths normalise correctly, including .. climbs. Clean.
